caribbean.headline: Bimini Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Bimini is experiencing sustained winds of 20 kt, waves up to 1.7 ft, and 88% rain probability. Martinique sees lighter winds up to 11 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Faces Strong Winds and 5.2ft Waves
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing 22 kt winds and 5.2 ft waves, with less than 10% rain probability. Venice sees 15 kt winds.
